newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.3 bln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.3 bln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.3 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$500 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$500 million of 26-week notes.
The RBA said it would take up an additional A$400 million of the five-week notes, A$200 million of the 13-week notes and A$400 million of the 26-week notes for its own portfolio.
Because of the Christmas/New Year holiday period, the next Treasury Note tender will be announced on December 30, the RBA said.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$700 million of notes, comprising A$200 million of five-week notes, A$200 million of 13-week notes and A$300 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$1.024 billion of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending December 19.
